title: Implement Guarantee section variant (guarantee-badge)
description: Implement a Guarantee section with a prominent guarantee badge, headline, and supporting copy. Used to build trust (e.g., 'Satisfaction Guarantee', '100% Money Back', 'Lifetime Warranty').
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: GuaranteeContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders headline, body text, and a large visual guarantee badge
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Create `src/components/shared/guarantee/GuaranteeBadge.tsx`, `index.ts`. Two-column layout: left side has large circular badge with badgeText (styled with --color-primary border and text), right side has headline + body copy. Badge should look like a physical guarantee stamp/seal using CSS (circle, bold text, dashed border).
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify guarantee badge is prominent and visually distinct.
